briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate model scale while DialectForge secures multi-agent protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs pushing 10T+ parameter systems amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding surges in infrastructure while safety lags deployment. Key tension centers on alignment failures in production agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4-preview with 4M context; xAI deploys Grok-3 at scale. Google Gemini 3.0 and Anthropic Claude 4.1 compete on benchmarks. Meta's Llama-4 open weights spark community forks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell clusters to Microsoft and CoreWeave. TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips. New data centers in Texas and UAE add 50GW capacity for training runs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory before 2027 AGI deployments?
